summary: Poetry is negotiation Symbols and sounds in a semiotic dance imprinted in our memory as Destiny fades across the night sky. Bringing dawns of new identities dripping on morning dew drawing light from constellation of stars dancing among our collective memories #poetryport #clmooc #DayLate
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Poetry is negotiation
Symbols and sounds
in a semiotic
dance imprinted
in our memory as
Destiny fades across
the night sky.
Bringing dawns
of new identities
dripping on morning
dew drawing light
from constellation of stars
dancing among our
collective memories
